title: Simultaneous compatible markings of a supplied normalized tower
statement: Let X,Y be schemes, g:Y to X any morphism, d an adic coefficient datum on A, M a normalized adic tower on X as in [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], and U an object of Y.ProEt. Put C=AdicCompletion(d.ideal,A) and J=d.ideal*C. Supply algebraic complexes K_n in D(C/J^(n+1)) and universal consecutive arrows t_n to quotient scalar restriction. Suppose each K_n is bounded, with finite module cohomology. Suppose, for each n separately, a covering sieve T_n on U has the following property: on every W to U in T_n, constantAdicQuotientRealization(W.hom followed by g,d,n)(K_n) is isomorphic to the actual inverse image of M_n. Then there is one covering sieve T on U, with a family b_n of such isomorphisms on every W to U in T. Write R_n for restriction to C, s_n for restriction of t_n followed by the specified composition comparisons, and z_n for constantAdicQuotientRightIso followed by restriction of b_n, as in [lem-weil-pbc-constant-adic-quotient-scalar-comparison]. For every n<=m, z_m followed by restriction of the actual M transition and the finite projection restriction compositor equals constantAdicFiniteRealization of the (m,n) map in Functor.ofOpSequence(s), followed by z_n. This theorem supplies only compatible markings of a supplied tower: it constructs no K, t, bounds, finite cohomology or vanishing transfer. It has no Noetherian or immersion assumption.

proof.text: Construct the finite etale Isom sheaves, their reduction maps and consecutive evaluation squares for the supplied levels; no compatible markings have yet been chosen.

Apply the finite-lisse tower section cover theorem to obtain affine weakly contractible V_i over U.left and compatible sections at every level. Compose with U.hom and generate a covering sieve on U. Factor any arrow in the sieve through one V_i and evaluate the sections to obtain b_n.

The consecutive evaluation squares define a natural transformation using NatTrans.ofOpSequence. Apply its naturality to (homOfLE h).op and identify the target sequential map with the actual all-pairs adic transition.

theorem lisse_tower_compatible_stalk_markings
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (M : AdicTower X d)
    (U : Y.ProEt)
    (K : ∀ n : ℕ, DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
      (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
        (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (t : ∀ n : ℕ, K (n + 1) ⟶
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
        (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right
          (I := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
          (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          (K n))
    (huniversal : ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1}
        (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1)))),
      Function.Bijective (fun k : K n ⟶ N ↦ t n ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right
            (I := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
            (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).mapDerivedCategory.map
            k))
    (hbounded : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, (q < a ∨ b < q) →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj (K n)))
    (hfinite : ∀ (n : ℕ) (q : ℤ), Module.Finite
      (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
          (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))) q).obj (K n)))
    (hmodels : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (K n) ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))) :
    let C := AdicCompletion d.ideal A
    let J := d.ideal.map (algebraMap A C)
    let R (n : ℕ) := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1}
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))
    let s (n : ℕ) := (R (n + 1)).mapDerivedCategory.map (t n) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u + 1, u + 1, u + 1} (Ideal.Quotient.factor
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))))
        (R (n + 1))).inv.app (K n) ≫
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'.{u + 1}
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 2)))
        (Ideal.Quotient.factor
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := J) (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (J ^ (n + 1)))
        (Ideal.Quotient.factor_comp_mk _).symm)).inv.app (K n)
    ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
      ∃ b : ∀ n : ℕ,
          (constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj (K n) ≅
            (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj
              (M.level n),
        let a := constantAdicFiniteRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d
        let H (n : ℕ) := pbcDerivedRestrict (constantAdicFiniteProjection (W.hom ≫ g) d n)
        let z (n : ℕ) :=
          (constantAdicQuotientRightIso (W.hom ≫ g) d n).hom.app (K n) ≫
            (H n).map (b n).hom
        ∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m),
          z m ≫ (H m).map (adicTowerRestrictedTransition d (W.hom ≫ g) M m n h) ≫
            (pbcDerivedRestrictComp
              (constantAdicFiniteProjection (W.hom ≫ g) d m)
              ((adicTowerInverseImage (W.hom ≫ g)).map (pbcAdicQuotient X d m n h))
              (constantAdicFiniteProjection (W.hom ≫ g) d n)
              (constantAdicFiniteProjection_comp (W.hom ≫ g) d m n h)).hom.app
                ((adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
                  ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n)) =
            a.map ((Functor.ofOpSequence
              (X := fun k : ℕ ↦ (R k).mapDerivedCategory.obj (K k)) s).map
                (homOfLE h).op) ≫ z n
